This page summarizes the methods Adriana works with, the populations she has studied, and where that expertise applies. Each item links to published work that uses it.

## A typical study, end to end {#workflow}

Most studies combine a behavioral measurement layer with one or more imaging modalities, then relate the two with an analysis approach matched to the design. The scheme follows Adriana's own overview figure, [*Brain connectivity, visual attention, and visual memory*](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.32064264) (figshare, CC BY 4.0).

::: {.rr-pipeline}
::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet .rr-step}
[1]{.rr-step-num aria-hidden="true"}

### Behavior

- Computerized visual attention and visual memory tasks
- Parameters from the theory of visual attention: processing speed, short-term memory capacity, top-down control, spatial weighting
- Neuropsychological assessment and questionnaires on subjective cognition
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet .rr-step}
[2]{.rr-step-num aria-hidden="true"}

### Brain

- Resting-state functional MRI
- Diffusion MRI: diffusion tensor and neurite density (NODDI) metrics, tractography
- Task-based functional MRI
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet .rr-step}
[3]{.rr-step-num aria-hidden="true"}

### Analysis

- Group-based comparisons
- Individual-differences analyses
- Longitudinal modeling, including latent growth curve and mediation models
:::
:::

## Methods in detail {#methods}

::: {.rr-grid .rr-grid-2}
::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Computational assessment of visual attention

Whole- and partial-report tasks modeled with Bundesen's theory of visual attention yield independent, latent-level parameters that are separate from motor speed. Used in healthy younger and older adults, amnestic mild cognitive impairment, and Parkinson's disease.

[Neurobiology of Aging 2017](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2017.03.029) · [Frontiers in Psychiatry 2023](https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyt.2023.1063151) · [Psychological Science 2021](https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797620965520)
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Intrinsic functional connectivity

Resting-state fMRI analyzed with independent component analysis and dual regression, network-level and inter-network connectivity, and frequency-specific analyses across slow-frequency bands.

[Neurobiology of Aging 2019](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2018.09.014) · [European Journal of Neuroscience 2021](https://doi.org/10.1111/ejn.15206) · [European Journal of Neurology 2022](https://doi.org/10.1111/ene.15445)
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Diffusion MRI and white matter

Fractional anisotropy and neurite density (NODDI) in major tracts such as the fornix and forceps minor, and probabilistic tractography of thalamo-cortical connections.

[NeuroImage 2022](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2022.119662) · [Neurobiology of Aging 2024](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2024.01.012) · [Methods in Molecular Biology 2024](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-0716-3774-6_8)
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Task fMRI and electrophysiology

Memory encoding and retrieval paradigms with functional MRI, and high-density (128-channel) event-related potentials in presymptomatic familial Alzheimer's disease.

[Archives of Clinical Neuropsychology 2022](https://doi.org/10.1093/arclin/acab061)
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Longitudinal and intervention designs

Latent growth curve and mediation models for multi-wave cohort data; training studies and randomized controlled trials with cognitive and imaging outcomes.

[Psychological Science 2021](https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797620965520) · [NeuroImage 2022](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2022.119662) · [Neurobiology of Aging 2024](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2024.01.012) · [medRxiv preprint 2026](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.31.26361810)
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Machine learning

Supervised classification with cross-validation, such as gradient boosting applied to open social data; in collaborative work, support vector machines on multimodal MRI.

[Journal of Computational Social Science 2022](https://doi.org/10.1007/s42001-022-00171-x)
:::
:::

## Populations and cohorts {#populations}

Healthy younger and older adults across the adult lifespan; older adults with subjective cognitive decline; patients with amnestic mild cognitive impairment; presymptomatic carriers of the PSEN1 E280A mutation for familial Alzheimer's disease in Colombia; participants of the DELCODE cohort study; and patients with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, or major depression.

## Where this expertise applies {#applications}

::: {.rr-grid .rr-grid-2}
::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Early detection and risk

Sensitive behavioral and imaging markers in people at risk of dementia, from genetic risk to subjective cognitive decline and mild cognitive impairment.
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Outcome measures for interventions and trials

Theory-based attention parameters and imaging outcomes for training, lifestyle, and clinical studies; early work contributed to composite cognitive endpoints for presymptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Clinical neurology

Cognitive and network characterization of symptoms such as fatigue, sleep problems, and visual processing deficits in multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease.
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Data for public benefit

Machine learning on open administrative data, as in predicting outcomes for older adults reported missing.
:::
:::
